name: Video Controls+
description: Playback speed from 0.25x to 3x, loop, frame stepping and picture-in-picture for videos in chat, plus YouTube-style keyboard shortcuts while you hover a video.

notes: Says what it needs, which is nothing beyond what Discord already shows it, and Evi holds it to that.
The speed menu slides in like Discord's menus, and fades out instead of vanishing.
